MRT Music Presents "Nanna Saradara" Hd Video Song From The Evergreen Kannada Movie "Samayada Gombe", Starring Dr. Rajkumar And Roopa Devi. This Beautiful Classic Kannada Song Features The Memorable Music Of Legendary Composer M. Ranga Rao.
Enjoy This Evergreen Kannada Old Hit Song In Hd And Relive The Golden Memories Of Classic Kannada Cinema. Listen To Beautiful Kannada Melodies, Old Kannada Movie Songs And Timeless Hits From The Golden Era Of Kannada Film Music.
Directed by: Dorai–Bhagavan
Produced by: Dorai–Bhagavan, Rathi Radhakrishna
Written by: Chi. Udayashankar
